I found the receipt, `receipt-rent-october.txt`. It reads "Receipt: rent October 2026, 9 500 kr, paid." It isn't linked to any note yet. The page already shows a "(receipt)" tag on any entry that has a `receipt` field, so it's ready for this.

I can edit the page to add an "Attach receipt" button on each entry, which you'd tap once for Rent. I can also add a one-time script that attaches a copy of the receipt to Rent the next time you open the page. Tell me which you'd like and I'll do it.
